standards.officialOutcomeText: Investigate and examine diversity within and among species, the importance of diversity and the various environments in which species live
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students explore and examine diversity within and among species, the importance of diversity and the various environments in which species live.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIKAE_89 > KAESCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 1

standards.officialOutcomeText: Examine the nature of reproductive processes and their role in transmitting species characteristics
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students explore the nature of reproductive processes and their role in transmitting species characteristics.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIKAE_89 > KAESCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 2

standards.sourceLocator: SCIKAE_89 > KAESCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 3

standards.officialOutcomeText: Apply science-related initiating and planning skills to ask questions about the relationships among observable variables at home, in the workplace and in the community

standards.officialOutcomeText: Apply science-related analyzing and interpreting skills to examine data and develop and assess possible explanations at home, in the workplace and in the community
